With the launch of the all-new Twelve South Airfly Drive wireless CarPlay adapter at $40, Amazon is once again updating its early autumn Prime Day promotions. 9to5Toys' "Afternoon Express" today features M5 MacBook Air models with discounts of up to $150, and the M5 Pro model with 2TB storage continuing to be discounted by $500, as well as a single 2026 Apple AirTag 2 dropping to an all-time low on Amazon. We also have the Sharge 300W power bank with metal body and smart display reduced by $50, multiple new low prices on Belkin 25W MagSafe chargers, and Eve Matter/HomeKit plugs, light switches, outlets and other products now available with official early autumn Prime Day promotions starting from as low as $32. See below for details.

Twelve South launches the all-new Airfly Drive wireless CarPlay and Android Auto adapter

After rolling out some early autumn Prime Day deals earlier, Twelve South is ready to launch the all-new Airfly Drive today. The newest member of the Airfly lineup — the all-new CarPlay and Android Auto adapter is now officially on sale for $39.99. There are plenty of no-name options on the market (and most aren't as polished as this), but Twelve South is finally joining the fray.

Complete vehicle compatibility list for the all-new Twelve South Airfly Drive CarPlay and Android Auto adapter

Early Autumn Prime Day deals: M5 MacBook Air models discounted up to $150

Aside from some of the official Apple refurbished deals that sold out quickly, Amazon's early autumn Prime Day promotions offer the best discounts on Apple's current M5 MacBook Air, with some models currently reduced by up to $150.

There are three configurations worth your attention right now — the base model, the 15-inch model with 24GB of memory, and this mid-tier 13-inch model. If you must have another configuration, we'd recommend sitting tight for now:

  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/1TB $1,449 (originally $1,599)
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/512GB $1,399 (originally $1,499)
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air 24GB/1TB $1,849 (originally $1,999)

The two upgraded configurations are $150 off the original price, while the base 15-inch model gets $100 off. As of now, these are discounts worth fighting for — the base model rarely sees deals, so $100 off is already pretty good; as for the upgraded configurations, be sure to wait until the $150 discount comes around before buying.

This discount also places it among the best MacBook deals in recent months — the 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro with 24GB of memory and 2TB of storage is $500 off.

This $500-off M5 Pro MacBook Pro may be the most worthwhile early autumn Prime Day deal right now

Amazon's early autumn Prime Day promotions are underway, with thousands of products seeing price cuts, but we want to highlight a notable Apple discount worth grabbing before it disappears. During Prime Day next week, the trajectory of the latest MacBook Pro lineup is hard to predict, but you can grab this M5 Pro 2TB model for $500 off right now.

Available in Space Black and Silver, Amazon is shipping the 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro with 24GB of memory, 2TB of storage, and an upgraded 18/20-core configuration for $2,699 with free shipping.

Single 2026 Apple AirTag 2 still available at an all-time low on Amazon

We've reported on the four-pack deals multiple times, but for consumers who don't need four, Amazon's early autumn Prime Day promotions are still selling Apple's 2026 AirTag 2 at an all-time low as a brand-new product.

Although this is only a $24 discount with free shipping for Prime members, don't forget this is a 2026 Apple product, and its regular pricing is already just $29.

  • AirTag 2 $24 (originally $29) — tying the all-time low

The four-pack is still $89 off — that's $22.50 per unit, but we've seen it drop another $9 lower multiple times over the past few months, and it's very likely to reappear during early autumn Prime Day next week.

Most affordable 2026 Studio Display model sees up to $300 off at Apple's official refurbished store

While Amazon's early autumn Prime Day deals are in full swing, Apple's official certified refurbished store is also offering discounts on the most affordable 2026 Apple Studio Display — $240 off the model with tilt-adjustable stand, and $300 off the model with tilt- and height-adjustable stand.

Apple's official refurbished store is once again shipping the 2026 Apple Studio Display with tilt-adjustable stand for $1,359 with free shipping. This $1,599 model is now $240 off; Amazon currently sells it for $1,550, and has never priced it below $1,484.

The 2026 model with tilt- and height-adjustable stand is now shipping for $1,699 with free shipping. This $1,999 display is effectively $300 off, well below Amazon's current $1,984 price — this brand-new unit has never sold for less than $1,886 on Amazon.

Eve official early autumn Prime Day deals officially launch: up to 38% off Matter/HomeKit switches, plugs, outlets and more, starting from $30

You can find a variety of well-reviewed HomeKit and Matter-compatible smart home products in Eve's official Amazon store, enjoying Prime Big Deal Days discounts with up to 38% savings.

Eve is one of the few brands that offers deals year-round, but it's during these special promotional events that prices truly drop significantly. Their lineup of smart home products supporting the Matter cross-platform standard — from outlets and smart plugs to light switches, water/leak detectors, motion sensors, and Motionblinds smart curtains — are now on sale at early autumn Prime Day prices.

All-new 2026 Kindle lineup

Amazon has also rolled out a major update to its 2026 Kindle lineup, with the standard Kindle, Paperwhite, and Colorsoft all seeing new versions for the first time. The new models feature a flush display, a thinner design, and depending on the version, multiple upgrades including faster performance, a higher-contrast screen, and a new aluminum back design. Updated versions are priced starting from $149.99 with free shipping for the standard Kindle, while the Paperwhite and Colorsoft start from $189.99 and $289.99 respectively.
